mapper.sql: id, product_no, product_name, category_id, title, main_image, price, origin_price, stock, sold_count, status, is_hot, version, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_product WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.product_no, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.title, p.main_image, p.price, p.origin_price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.status, p.is_hot, p.version, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted FROM t_product p INNER JOIN t_seckill_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.id WHERE sp.activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT p.id, p.product_no, p.product_name, p.category_id, p.title, p.main_image, p.price, p.origin_price, p.stock, p.sold_count, p.status, p.is_hot, p.version, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted FROM t_product p INNER JOIN t_seckill_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.id INNER JOIN t_seckill_activity a ON a.id = sp.activity_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN (0, 1) AND a.end_time > NOW() AND a.start_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{aheadSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY a.start_time
